slides.title: Sole trader or limited company?
slides.sub: What each one actually means, in plain English.

slides.title: Sole trader
body: You and the business are the same.
You are personally responsible for all its debts.
You pay Income Tax through Self Assessment.

slides.title: Limited company
body: The company is legally separate from its owners.
It pays Corporation Tax on its profits.
There are rules on taking money out.

slides.title: A director's yearly jobs
body: File a Company Tax Return and pay Corporation Tax.
Check your details with Companies House each year (confirmation statement).

slides.title: Weighing it up?
body: There is no one right answer for everyone.
Ask Hustle Mate to understand the trade-offs.
